arguments.name: currencyCode
arguments.description: The unique code identifier for the currency to update (e.g., "000008")

raw.name: currencyCode
raw.description: The unique code identifier for the currency to update (e.g., "000008")

arguments.name: currencyName
arguments.description:
The current name of the currency to update (e.g., "Euro")
The user must provide ONE identification field and at least ONE update field.

raw.name: currencyName
raw.description:
The current name of the currency to update (e.g., "Euro")
The user must provide ONE identification field and at least ONE update field.

arguments.name: currencySymbol
arguments.description:
The current symbol of the currency to update (e.g., "AUD," "USD");
NOTE: currencySymbol is not currency symbol like "$"; it is a combination of letters, "USD."

raw.name: currencySymbol
raw.description:
The current symbol of the currency to update (e.g., "AUD," "USD");
NOTE: currencySymbol is not currency symbol like "$"; it is a combination of letters, "USD."

arguments.name: newCurrencyName
arguments.description: The new name for the currency

raw.name: newCurrencyName
raw.description: The new name for the currency

arguments.name: newCurrencySymbol
arguments.description:
The new symbol for the currency
NOTE: currencySymbol is not currency symbol like "$"; it is a combination of letters, "USD."

raw.name: newCurrencySymbol
raw.description:
The new symbol for the currency
NOTE: currencySymbol is not currency symbol like "$"; it is a combination of letters, "USD."

arguments.name: isBaseCurrency
arguments.description:
Set as base currency - accepts string "true" or "false"
Only 1 base currency can exist in the system.

raw.name: isBaseCurrency
raw.description:
Set as base currency - accepts string "true" or "false"
Only 1 base currency can exist in the system.

arguments.name: exchangeRate
arguments.description: New exchange rate value to update (example: "1.12"). If the currency is set as base, the rate will be forced to "1".

raw.name: exchangeRate
raw.description: New exchange rate value to update (example: "1.12"). If the currency is set as base, the rate will be forced to "1".
